review_type: Human review of 315 initially accepted Turkish Wikipedia lead facts, 2026-11-12
scope: Manual read of every accepted first-sentence fact for obvious errors, wrong sense, outdated claims and malformed Turkish; other undiscovered inaccuracies can remain.
